mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 37 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Fireman's Park and a waxing crescent moon above. Please note that while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. We will see an overnight low of 30 degrees with no rain predicted.
City news highlights include the upcoming Plan Commission review of the Sub-Zero project at Liberty Business Park and important public notices regarding the upcoming general election.

There is plenty to do, with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today. Tomorrow brings the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol, live music at Paddy Mac's, and a John Denver tribute concert at the High School Fine Arts Center.
Regarding local public safety, on October 25, officers arrested a man for an O W I after he was discovered unresponsive in his vehicle at a local intersection.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is Raspberry Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving this treat until they close at 10:30 PM.
